title: Not worth the money...
text: Totally not worth the price and got the worst colors and the products probably didn’t even add up to the value of the box. I was so disappointed. I will be trying sketchbox and if I’m unhappy with that box, I will be sticking to The Inky Box.  I heard great things about artsnacks but my experience with the box was not a good one. Although they did refund me fully for the box because I was dissatisfied. So I will say the customer service dept really worked with me.
label: negative
